snippet.title: Cursemark - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From LA 2026
snippet.description:
A gameplay trailer for Cursemark. Hack, slash, and cast your way through a haunted kingdom brimming with secrets where no two builds are ever the same. As a cursed mage-knight you will unlock devastating spells, equip ability transforming runes, and reforge your curse on the path to victory or death in this fantasy action roguelite.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
